svg.title: Coding activity per language over time
svg.desc: Heatmap of the lines of code I changed per month and language, Aug 2023 to Nov 2026. Most changed overall: TypeScript (212,320 lines), JavaScript (33,027 lines), Python (7,465 lines). 2023: mostly TypeScript; 2024: mostly TypeScript; 2025: mostly TypeScript; 2026: mostly TypeScript.
